caption: The drawing features a quilt-like design composed of 36 square blocks arranged in a 6-by-6 grid, each block displaying a unique arrangement and combination of colors and patterns. The predominant colors in the drawing are red, blue, green, pink, brown, beige, and various shades of gray and black, with occasional use of lighter hues such as white and turquoise. Each block is constructed from repeated geometric forms that radiate out from the center, creating a layered, concentric effect. The centers of the blocks are typically square or rectangular, and are surrounded by bands or strips that alternate in color and direction, simulating a pieced fabric effect with some featuring diagonal hatching, checks, and solid colors. The overall composition is framed by a simple, thin border line. Below the main drawing, on the cream-colored background, "Westchester County" is written in the bottom left, and "Drawn by Wm P. Shearwood" in the bottom right, both in cursive script.
title: Quilt
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
